facts.detail: Ofcom published the TAR 2026-31 statement on 17 March 2026.
The statement page was last updated on 13 May 2026.
The decisions regulate fixed telecoms markets from April 2026 to March 2031.
The regulated fixed markets underpin broadband, mobile and business connections.
The decisions are designed to promote competition and investment in gigabit-capable networks.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the full-fibre regulation announcement on 17 March 2026.
The announcement describes rules applying through the next five-year regulatory period.
Ofcom reported full-fibre availability at 78% of UK homes.
The reported 78% availability was up from less than a quarter of homes five years earlier.
The framework leaves room for gradual Openreach deregulation only where effective competition develops.
